attempts_observed.note: two earlier review dispatches of this run were superseded before storing anything; no prior record existed at the fenced path, so this record carries no superseded verdict

findings.text: the refusal reddens 31 existing tests in tests/test_ledger.py with no record of it: that file measures 4 failed / 91 passed at dd09c6d7 and 35 failed / 60 passed at 3cae6100 while being byte-identical across the two revisions, since every one of the added failures calls append_run as the way to create a fresh project, so the breakage is visible to any later suite run but absent from the manifest, from follow_ons and from the plan record.

the docstring names allow_create=True as the route for a genuinely new project, but the sole production caller, reckon/crew/promotion.py:3606, never passes it, so at this revision a new project cannot initialise a ledger through any production path and the door the refusal offers is reachable only from tests.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit — 89a574d2 is the guard plus its four-case file (reckon/ledger.py 33 added, 5 removed; the new test file 74 added) and 3cae6100 is the landing record, and the plan diff adds one comment block without touching the plan-version or plan-modified meta lines.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when named tests/test_a_promotion_never_creates_a_ledger.py with three assertions, a pasted ruff delta, and a rule that an out-of-scope failure is reported under follow_ons; I re-ran that file in the reviewed worktree at 3cae6100 (4 passed, exit 0), read the three assertions, and confirmed the ruff digits are pasted, but the follow_ons rule was not honoured for the module failures this change adds.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal was to refuse a promotion that finds no ledger file instead of letting it write a fresh store, and the landed code does that at reckon/ledger.py:1752, refusing the absent resolved ledger before the shadow-store write and naming the file, the run store and the explicit initialisation route, with reckon/ledger.py:649-658 refusing a present ledger whose members or runs are not lists.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it names both commits, base dd09c6d7, the focused and adjacent counts with their logs, the reproduction and negative-control receipts, and honestly records baseline_suite completed:false and an after_suite covering only the new four-case file, so it is complete about what it looked at and silent about the module it runs inside.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares five paths and the full diff dd09c6d7..3cae6100 touches four of them, with both HTML records insertions-only (31 and 5 added lines, 0 removed) and no path outside the set, so the write fence held even though the declared figure directory went unused.

justifications.durability: the guard is pinned by four focused cases and the committed blob at 3cae6100 carries allow_create, but the landed revision leaves 31 pre-existing module tests red with no attribution, so the next suite gate inherits failures this change caused.
justifications.evidence: the run's receipts are real — the reproduction log shows absent_write_version=1 beside the 1267->1 refusal and the negative control reddens with DID NOT RAISE LedgerError — but its only suite measurement is its own new file (baseline not established) and follow_ons is none, so the 31 tests its guard reddens in tests/test_ledger.py went unmeasured.
justifications.fit: the refusal speaks in the module's own voice and names the module's own _run_store_location() at reckon/ledger.py:1755, but the remedy it names, allow_create=True, has no production caller — promotion.py:3606 is the only one and does not pass it.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/ledger.py:1752 refuses the absent ledger before any write and 649-658 refuses the malformed collections, which is the goal's refusal plus the same collapse it named.
justifications.scope_discipline: `git diff --numstat dd09c6d7 3cae6100` lists exactly the declared paths with both HTML records append-only, but tests/test_ledger.py, the file this change visibly breaks, is left outside the record entirely.
